author: abblix.com
name: Abblix OpenID Provider - Getting Started (in-memory)
description: A minimal OpenID Provider on Abblix OIDC Server for learning: in-memory user and client stores and an ephemeral signing key, with talking comments and warnings that point at the production choices. For a production-shaped starter, use the abblix-oidc-server template instead.

HttpsPort.description: Port for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json.

user.description: Email/login of a dev sample user to pre-seed. If omitted, no sample user is created.

password.description: Password for the --user sample account. Dev-only: stored and compared in plaintext. Ignored when --user is omitted.
